lens: E - US and Asian trends not yet in the EU
slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Nordic Car-Nap Cushion-Blanket
ideas.concept: Dual-function car seat cushion that unfolds into a large travel blanket, designed in Scandinavian textile and colour for road trips and winter car waiting.
ideas.target_customer: Car commuters and road-trippers in SE/DK, design-minded 25-45, gifting.
ideas.problem_solved: Cold, uncomfortable car cabins on long trips; single-use cushions.
ideas.trend_evidence: 3COINS Japan launched a cushion that unfolds into a 100x150cm blanket at 1320 yen aimed at overnight car use; Daiso sells car sleeping gear (110-550 yen). Only Japanese retail coverage seen; no EU sales data verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own textile design/pattern and fold mechanism (design registration), brand; weak moat otherwise, copyable by generic sellers.

ideas.name: Model-Specific Car Window Privacy Set
ideas.concept: Magnetic/fitted window privacy and sun curtains made per popular Nordic car models (e.g. Tesla Model Y, Volvo EX30/XC40, VW ID.4), sold as complete sets.
ideas.target_customer: EV owners and camper-curious car owners in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: Privacy, heat and cold for car naps, camping and charging stops; generic curtains fit poorly.
ideas.trend_evidence: Korean chabak car-camping culture sells vehicle-specific mattresses, curtains and leveling boards (e.g. Kkomjirak); Hyundai newsroom covers the trend; Daiso sells magnetic window curtains in Japan. Most Korean accessory coverage seen is 2020-21, 2026 sources are event coverage; EU demand not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Per-model pattern library and fit accuracy (SKU breadth as moat), supplier exclusivity on patterns; sizeable SKU complexity is a risk.
ideas.tooling_needed: Cutting patterns only; no moulds. Needs vehicle measuring/samples.

ideas.name: Dog Enrichment Combo: Slow-Feed Lick Mat Set
ideas.concept: Design-led silicone slow-feeder bowl with removable lick mat and freezer-safe insert, in muted Nordic colours with a refillable treat-recipe card system.
ideas.target_customer: Urban dog owners in SE/DK, enrichment-minded, 25-45.
ideas.problem_solved: Boredom, fast eating and anxiety when left alone; ugly plastic products.
ideas.trend_evidence: Pet Age reports enrichment moving from niche to necessity with social-media-driven demand; Trend Hunter highlights combined slow-feeder + lick-mat products; Exploding Topics cites lick mat search growth (marketing source, dated). US is already crowded (SodaPup, Outward Hound), so EU stage is growth to flooded on Amazon.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Proprietary mould shape (silicone compression mould, low cost) plus design registration and recipe content community; modest moat.
ideas.tooling_needed: Silicone compression mould, est. EUR 500-1,500 (not steel injection).

ideas.name: Road-Trip Dog Tie-Out Anchor
ideas.concept: Portable weighted/stake-free dog anchor for campsites, beaches and car stops, adapted for EU leash norms with a washable cover.
ideas.target_customer: Camper-van, car-camping and beach dog owners in Nordics.
ideas.problem_solved: Safe temporary tie-out without drilling stakes into ground.
ideas.trend_evidence: Pup Stack (portable dog anchor for road trips and campsites) appeared on Shark Tank S18E3 asking $150k for 10%; sources conflict on deal status. No EU equivalent verified; metal weight plates raise shipping weight.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design registration and possible patent-around; heavy and tooling-light but copyable. Weight and tie-out legality in DK (leash laws) need checking.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stamped/cast plates, possibly under EUR 2k; verify. Weight may exceed target.

ideas.name: Windowsill Self-Watering Herb Planter Set
ideas.concept: Slim self-watering wicking planters sized for windowsills and balcony rails with a seed-pod refill subscription (consumable).
ideas.target_customer: Apartment dwellers in SE/DK, indoor-gardening beginners.
ideas.problem_solved: Plants dying from missed watering; bulky pots that do not fit sills.
ideas.trend_evidence: Trend Hunter and SaleHoo list self-watering planters as growing; TikTok-recommended self-watering pots at about $14 on Amazon US. Sources are dropship/sourcing sites with commercial interest; category is likely crowded.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Differentiate via daylight/indoor-climate-fit sizing and refill pods; moat is weak, so treat as a fallback.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock ceramic/plastic with custom print; custom mould avoided.

ideas.name: Compact Pet Home-Fit Accessories (Japan-style)
ideas.concept: Small-apartment pet accessories (odour-sealing treat tin, tidy feeding mat, foldable travel bowl) in interior-matching design.
ideas.target_customer: Urban pet owners in Copenhagen/Stockholm flats.
ideas.problem_solved: Clutter and ugly pet gear in small homes.
ideas.trend_evidence: IMARC and Al Jazeera (July 2026) report Japan pet care booming, with compact, interior-matching accessories and odour control noted; no product-level Daiso/3COINS data found and sources are market-report summaries, so product demand is unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Brand and design language, bundle system with refills; weak IP.
ideas.tooling_needed: Stock shapes with custom finish; no new tooling.
